ex.definition: Someone you were in a relationship with and are no longer in one.
ex.example: My ex and I still share a group of friends, so we keep it simple.

lift.definition: The upward push that the wings make on a plane. It is what holds the plane in the air.
lift.example: More speed means more lift on the wings.

mon_base_currency.definition: The currency of the pair that the rate counts from: one unit of it is the thing you exchange.
mon_base_currency.example: In EUR/USD the euro is the base currency and the dollar is the quote currency.

regrade.definition: A change of level within the same job, which usually comes with a pay band change.
regrade.example: They suggested a regrade to senior analyst.
